title: MFD Stage-3 execution manifest (No.10 audit-response revision) - NOT AN EXECUTION PERMIT
execution_status: NOT_AUTHORIZED: main (6400) and aux (660) runs have not been started. Each set needs its OWN signed authorization record issued by the research lead after the independent re-audit
aggregator: single process (workers compute only; no file writes)

frozen_conditions.conditional_extension: +10 tu min until ||grad U||_2<=1e-2 over 5 tu; if not converged at +40 tu continue to +100 tu

composition.aux0: ns{5,2,12} x a=0 x seeds 0-19 at D_max=500 = 60

retention.algorithm: u=int.from_bytes(SHA256('{seed}:{trial_key}')[:8],'big')/2**64; optional full trajectory iff u<0.10 and not mandatory; result-independent; one full file per trial

main.note: time budget is monitored (ETA), not enforced by MFDRunner.run

budgets.note_aux_budget: aux 2.5 h / 1.5 GB taken from the instruction plan; soft = 90% of hard (same ratio as 4.5/5 GB)
budgets.time_operation: monitoring + safe-stop procedure (option B of mfd_rbsh_v2_time_budget_operation.md; recommended, awaiting the research lead's decision); monitor: mfd_rbsh_v2_progress.py (read-only)

roles.soft_limit: operating limit: store decisions (optional skipped first) and pre-run prediction
roles.hard_limit: absolute ceiling: periodic end-state scan; exceeding stops safely

completion_states.INCOMPLETE: computed but mandatory storage not finished; reprocessed

storage_rules.full: M2 (byte-shuffle + LZMA preset 6; per-array and container SHA-256; tmp+fsync+os.replace; read-back verify)
storage_rules.ledger: append-only; torn lines preserved in ledger_torn.jsonl

stop_conditions: mandatory full trajectory cannot be stored (capacity / free disk / write failure) -> safe stop after writing a non-COMPLETE ledger row
prediction + used > soft limit at start
resume_conditions: rerun same command; done set = COMPLETE ledger rows only; torn ledger lines preserved; orphan files reused/quarantined; attempts and previous_states recorded

environment.thread_determinism_check: 2 trials, OPENBLAS threads 1/2/default: identical array SHA-256 (thread_determinism.txt); limited (2 cores)

driver: mfd_rbsh_v2_run_driver.py (default dry-run incl. freeze-manifest verification; --execute needs --auth-file + key via MFD_RBSH_AUTH_KEY/--key-file; see authorization_guard)
history_notes: v9: pre-0-d-fix controller hash was not recorded (kept as history note)
v9 bundle MANIFEST.sha256 listed itself (empty-file hash) -> self-check shows 1 FAILED line; not a data defect; v10 manifest excludes itself
integration script v10: wrong v9 ledger path fixed once (verification code only), rerun; hash before 3e33b0bf..., after df681faa...

No.10 audit: legacy (no 'completion') ledger rows were interpreted as COMPLETE (fixed: refused); unknown free space was treated as storable (fixed); env-var-only execution guard replaced by signed per-set authorization
No.10 final bundle (rbsh3) is superseded by rbsh4; its files are kept as history

authorization_guard.issuer_tool: mfd_rbsh_v2_auth_tool.py (research lead only: keygen / issue / verify)
authorization_guard.signature: HMAC-SHA256 with a secret key held by the research lead and supplied at run time (not stored in the repository)
checks_at_execute: freeze manifest covers table and execution manifest
output directory bound to one set and one approval id (RUN_START events)
authorization_guard.limits: stops accidental, stale, mismatched or key-less executions; cannot stop someone who holds both key and files

ledger_rules.legacy_or_foreign_rows: run refused (LedgerFormatError), nothing written or reinterpreted
ledger_rules.complete_row_trust: COMPLETE rows are re-verified on resume (tier-1 size, full-trajectory existence and SHA-256, mandatory stored); failures are demoted to INTERRUPTED and re-run
ledger_rules.free_space_unknown: treated as not storable: safe stop / refusal to start
